summary: Alma Mater casts players as heads of a Renaissance university competing to recruit professors and students and build prestige across four academic disciplines. It's a dense euro of worker placement and drafting with an engine-building feel, aimed at experienced gamers.
praised: rich thematic integration of academic life
deep interlocking systems for building an engine
criticised: steep learning curve and dense rulebook
iconography and complexity can feel overwhelming

interaction.kind: worker placement and drafting over a shared market of professors and students
interaction.detail: Players place workers and draft staff/students from limited shared pools, so taking a strong professor or student is often chosen because a rival wanted it. Each player still builds their own faculty's reputation and disciplines independently on their own board.

subsystems: student teaching & examinations across four disciplines
sources: experience points earned from teaching, converted to VP
scoring.how_you_win: Recruit staff and students, teach across the four disciplines to graduate students and accrue experience, and construct buildings; the highest combined victory-point total at the end of the fixed number of rounds wins.
